div.div: There are no fixed tasks. There is one module issue for each part of the project (Simulator core and rules, Body models, Scripted bots, Game loop and controls, Game server and API, Browser page, Planners, League and training, Dataset tools, Research logging and contribution, Command line, Documentation and build). If you find a gap, open a sub-issue under the module issue and agree the scope with the maintainer first.
